what: deep agents: hand-written REINFORCE network and Stable-Baselines3 DQN and PPO, on the drive (exact regret, expected points) and the last five minutes (regret in win probability from summed exact per-decision losses on a fixed set of start states)

endgame_setup.opponent: solved optimal policy (variant: coach-like policy of the simulator)
endgame_setup.reward: 1 win, 0.5 tie after regulation, 0 loss, at the end only
endgame_setup.step: one play call of the agent's team; the opponent's plays happen inside step
endgame_setup.action_mapping: actions the model does not allow are played as the neutral play; evaluation takes the greedy action among allowed actions

dp_cost.method: backward induction, last 5:00 (60 slices) of mdp_game.solve

stamp.what: solved game model (components plus count, mode and coach tables)

dynamic_kickoff_2024.reason: rule constant; no data under this rule exists before the season

dynamic_kickoff_2025.reason: rule constant; no data under this rule exists before the season

stamp.note: the only test-season content is the components' kickoff rule tables; the solved game uses the latest rule's table for every kickoff

note_on_time: runs execute in `workers` parallel processes on a shared machine; the wall time of a full run is about the sum over runs divided by the number of workers
